job.title: Room Attendants - Queenstown
job.description:
Room Attendants – Queenstown

Part time
$27.00 per hour (NZD)
30 hours per week

Unleash Your Potential with ahs hospitality! Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey in the heart of hospitality? ahs hospitality is looking for passionate individuals to be part of our dynamic team in Queenstown.

We are seeking 10 Housekeepers / Room Attendants to join our teams working in Queenstown.

Service with a smile is our mantra, and we truly believe we are the best outsourced service company you could choose to work with.

What’s in it for you?
  • Competitive hourly rate: $27.00 per hour
  • Paid training and development opportunities
  • Be part of a tight-knit, passionate team that values your contributions
Why Choose ahs hospitality? We’re not just a company; we’re a community that believes in service with a smile. As the largest provider of outsourced housekeeping management services in Australia and New Zealand, we’re proud partners with iconic hotel brands.

Key Responsibilities
  • Completing allocated rooms within the allocated time
  • Replenishing and controlling guest supplies and amenities, including bathroom amenities, mini bar, towels and linen
  • Preparing each room to the required standard
  • Rotating and replacing room items in accordance with set requirements, such as mattress protectors, bedspreads and pillows
  • Reporting missing items from guest rooms, such as kettles, cups, glasses, irons and hangers
  • Presenting guest rooms to hotel standards
  • Providing buddy training when directed by the manager or supervisor
  • Following company policies and procedure manuals
  • Reporting maintenance required in rooms
The Ideal Candidate To succeed in this role, you should have:

  • Attention to detail and a passion for cleanliness
  • Ability to work well in a team environment
  • Good communication and customer service skills
  • Comfort with physical tasks
  • Ability to work efficiently while maintaining quality
  • A professional and reliable attitude
  • Flexibility to work rostered shifts, including weekends and public holidays where required
  • Good time management and organisational skills
Qualifications No formal qualification or previous work experience is required. On-the-job training will be provided.

Join Us! At AHS Hospitality New Zealand, we celebrate diversity and believe an inclusive work environment fuels creativity, flexibility and superior organisational performance. Embracing Aotearoa New Zealand’s Pacific identity, we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including Pasifika communities, and are deeply committed to the growth of our team members.

Join us in delivering extraordinary experiences to our clients. Apply now to embark on a rewarding career with ahs hospitality!
